description:
Greetings, 
 My name is Raju. We do have a job opening for the position MSTR Developer Position @ NJ . with one of our clients. Please go through the job description mentioned below and if you find it interesting then send me an updated copy of your resume on my email ID at rajud(at)hsssoft(dot)com 
 –or you can call me at 732-201-4118 ASAP 
 Role : MSTR Developer . 
 Location : NJ. 
 
 Duration : Full time. 
 
 Requisition Details: 
 MSTR SDK Dev 
 Job requirements: 
 • Strong knowledge of Core Java, HTML, CSS and RESTful APIs is a must. 
 • Familiarity of MSTR Web APIs & SDKs for customizing analytical applications is a must. 
 • Integrate MSTR Web into portals such as Microsoft SharePoint, IBM WebSphere, and Oracle WebLogic using the Web SDK. 
 • Must have implemented Single Sign-On within portals. 
 • Familiarity with Web standards such as XML is recommended. 
 • Familiarity of MSTR Mobile APIs & SDKs for customizing mobile applications is a must. 
 Job Description: 
 •Experience Level : Min. 2yrs – 4 yrs of experience in MSTR SDK customization across Web and Mobile. 
 •Report development experience is a big plus. 
 •Experience in working with a large MSTR Development Team is a must. Support experience will not be preferred. 
 •Hands-on development/maintenance experience in MSTR 9.4 and 10 versions, Knowledge/Experience on enterprise portal integration, mobile integration, write back to source data based on analysis by business users, alerts via mail, mobile based on pre-defined events (Ask candidates to list down the SDK Customizations done on their projects as a clear call-out similar to the below samples) 
 SDK customizations of Web UI Interfaces Ø (Logo/Footer/favicon/Remove any sections on WELCOME or DESKTOP Screens) 
 SDK customization on integrating MSTR Ø Reports/Dashboards into Client web portals (Sharepoint/WebSphere/etc) 
 • Strong Analytical and Problem solving skills. 
 •Experience in working with Onsite Offshore team is a must. 
 Thanks and regards 
 Raju 
 Email:rajud(at)hsssoft(dot)com 
 Mobile:732-201-4118 


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
